driverHistory.scope: Two earlier tick-zero planning failures and two completed historical driver rounds are preserved separately from the final six actual rounds.

historicalAttempts.scope: First attempt stopped at initial tick zero, before any input.
L1 actual win and deliberate deadline loss passed; L2 stopped at tick zero by conservative idle-navigation forecast. Preserved as historical driver evidence.

changes: Only two default controlDelayTicks values 20→16 and one explanatory comment. The 16-tick value is the arithmetic mean of 13/16/19 ticks between commands under the existing polling schedule, not a worst-case promise. Actual six-round and browser outcomes remain required.

Remember next id from the last public schedule; while task is active, use only directions to preselect it, verifying unchanged task identity. Never press B or start a second task. Replan from actual state after completion.

independentReview.scope: Independent offline arithmetic and event-constraint review of the six existing v3 ordinary rounds. No model, controller, browser or private witness execution/access.
method: Event before/after snapshots define constant phase, occupancy and isolation intervals. Each interval uses cumulative closed-form flows; global resources and ledgers continue from the authored initial state without resetting to observed inventories.
Net recovery after n ticks is min(.9*A0,n*r,headroom0+(n-1)*min(consumption,r)); the offset preserves capacity limits before same-tick consumption.

Check each observed phase transition at its first empty/full or exact 120/180 active-tick boundary, task identity/exclusivity, one migration per leg, old-occupancy breath, isolation-end leakage and every recorded door state.
Re-evaluate first terminal tick from independent inventories/shortfalls and verified migration/isolation events; compare all retained, transition, operation and compact checkpoints.
limitations: The public projection excludes pilot diagnostics; original raw hashes are provenance from the approved index, not a claim that this reviewer inspected forbidden diagnostic bytes.
This validates observed event timing and arithmetic, not a second implementation of input navigation, scheduling or the complete production state machine.
Only actually present ordinary stop, exhaustion, pressure and exact-deadline cases count as production coverage. Three hand fixtures test the oracle only; they are not additional game rounds.
A span continuing after first numerical depletion with unfinished groups is rejected for explicit review, including the possible sub-EPS-shortfall continuation edge; gates are not silently relaxed.

capacityLimitedTicks lacks an exact public comparison predicate. Its reported value is retained for context; independent capacity evidence instead uses actual headroom-limited transfer and stage duration.
No post-terminal freeze, pause/retry/cancel/subtick or physical-device claim is made. Simultaneous terminal priorities and exact deadline arrival are not presumed covered by ordinary rounds.

candidateNormalPlay.eventScope: Trace contains only actual public observations. Transient events missed between observations are not fabricated; persistent operations/completedTasks, actual personnel arrivals and the resource ledger remain available.

recordingHistory.availableEvidence: 119 original compositor JPEGs and returned stderr. The common recorder did not persist inputs, sampled states, exact last-pilot tick, call duration or timestamps on this exception.
recordingHistory.firstAttemptCauseStatus: Startup/input or observation timing is suspected. Exact cause is not proven by the retained evidence; no production physics failure or precise elapsed tick is claimed.
recordingHistory.firstAttemptProposedCorrection: Scratch recorder keeps existing observations on failure; Enter becomes separate down/up (7.4/7.44) without blocking the 80ms feedback loop. Frozen automation, physics and all pass criteria remain unchanged.
recordingHistory.correction: Enter splitting alone did not fix capture. The second actual report shows a direction press released at the same model tick. The reviewed scratch recorder now retains held keys and skips pilot/applyKeys until that tick advances; 80ms observation polling and frozen game sources are unchanged.
recordingHistory.scope: The first attempt has no reconstructed states, inputs, exact tick or timestamps. The second retains actual observations. Both failed captures remain history; prior successful formal, ordinary and UI reports are reused.

gameRules.scope: Finite oxygen, one pump, real safe doors and timed personnel migration. Independent offline arithmetic uses final-v3 public observations; earlier controller attempts remain explicit. Release checks do not constitute independent review by the game designer.

modelTests.scope: Directed model rule and input tests. Any synthetic fixtures are explicitly labelled in the test source. This is not browser, ordinary full-round, or physical-device evidence.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryAirlockManagement.scope: Actual key edges and observed operation/task receipts only. Permanent completed tasks and arrivals are observed facts; missed transient events, operation ticks and exact image states are not reconstructed.

recorderTickGuard.scope: Actual saved poll records only; no extra game or reconstructed tick.

equipmentStoppedReview.scope: Actual stopped equipment in the existing input test. Clock, respiration and leak continue throughout this true before/after image window; no global pause or state/time injection.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
